name: Steven Madden
outlook:
What Steven Madden says to expect

  • Fiscal 2026: revenue growthThe Company now expects fiscal 2026 revenue to increase 12% to 13% compared with fiscal 2025, versus its previous guidance range of an 11% to 13% increase.
  • Fiscal 2026: diluted and adjusted diluted EPSThe Company now expects fiscal 2026 diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) to be in the range of $2.58 to $2.63, compared to its previous guidance range of $2.55 to $2.65. The Company now expects Adjusted diluted EPS to be in the range of $2.15 to $2.20, up from its previous guidance range of $2.05 to $2.15.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
